content:
Enabling audit logs is a two-step process. First, you conﬁgure your domain to publish audit logs to
CloudWatch Logs. Then, you enable audit logs in OpenSearch Dashboards and conﬁgure them to
meet your needs.
Important
If you encounter an error while following these steps, see the section called “Can't enable
audit logs” for troubleshooting information.
